request.subject: Continuous feed of admin activity into our security monitoring
request.body: Our security operations team currently downloads the admin activity file by hand every month and loads it into Microsoft Sentinel. They'd like those events to flow in continuously (near-real-time is fine) so they can alert on role changes and token use. Is that something you can do? Note our data has to stay in the EU.

rationale: 20-docs-audit-log.md states streaming audit events to an external SIEM is not supported. No existing work covers it: work_audit_log_csv_download is the done 365-day CSV feature the customer already uses; webhooks (20-docs-webhooks.md) only emit alert/export/user-deactivated events, and work_webhook_retry_queue is about delivery durability. New work on cap_audit_log, owned by its capability owner person_jonas (team_identity), with the EU-residency constraint from customer_corvid in the acceptance criteria. No decision restricts Corvid's action types.
